content.text: I found the public event brief. One key correction: **Databricks is optional**, with a separate ₹50,000 award pool; your Graph Intelligence track is part of the main Entire challenge. The event also includes a mandatory surprise requirement at noon, so teams must show how they adapt a working product.

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/shaurya/Desktop/BTW/hackathon-notes.md
+# BTW Buildathon — discussion notes
+
+Checked 6 September 2026. The supplied dashboard requires sign-in; the public event brief was readable. These are research notes, not a competition implementation or submission.
+
+## Event
+
+- 6 September, Scaler School of Technology, Electronic City, Bengaluru.
+- Check-in 8 AM; build 9 AM–4 PM; judging 4–5 PM IST.
+- Start in a new Entire repository fork, mirror it on Entire in the India region, and use the mirror clone. Enable Checkpoints and use Graph.
+- Noon: preserve a stable checkpoint, start a fresh agent session, and adapt to the mandatory new constraint.
+- Submit a working demo, repository/final commit, tests/setup, BUILDATHON.md, Entire mirror, Checkpoints and Graph evidence.
+
+## Your track: Build with Graph Intelligence
+
+Use code relationships to help a developer make a decision. Examples from your screenshot: reviewing change impact, choosing tests, planning migrations, onboarding, and connecting code structure with recorded intent. A raw graph display alone is insufficient.
+
+Entire Graph maps definitions, callers and dependencies to source locations. Entire Checkpoints preserve the coding-session context behind changes. Graph findings need verification against source and tests.
+
+## Databricks
+
+A cloud workspace for storing, processing and analyzing data, running Python/SQL notebooks, and building data/AI applications. Free Edition supports experimentation with usage limits.
+
+Illustrative workflow, not a chosen project: Entire Graph identifies affected code; Databricks combines that evidence with test history to rank suggested tests; the interface shows recommendations and their supporting evidence.
+
+## Sources
+
+- [Official event brief](https://build.bengalurutechweek.com/)
+- [Event listing and prizes](https://luma.com/btwbuildathon26)
+- [Entire Graph](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph)
+- [Entire](https://entire.io/)
+- [Databricks overview](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/introduction)
+- [Databricks Free Edition](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/getting-started/free-edition)
+
+Team-size, selection and eligibility rules remain in the application/participation rules; they were not accessible through the signed-out dashboard.
*** End Patch"));
